column1: # Requests the specification (scenario.tsv) leaves open, where each program
# answers by its framework's defaults, or for the Authorization field by its
# own parser (the Muntin program's hand-written one, Flare's
# parse_bearer_token): one per line, tab-separated: method, target,
# Authorization value (- for none), request body (- for none), Content-Type
# sent (- for none). Each is sent to each program, started for that request
# with MAX_TEXT 40 on a journal holding ada's note 1 and bo's note 2;
# scripts/compare_notes.py prints the answers and what each program wrote to
# standard output and standard error, and checks nothing.
